## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a Conventional Commit (`feat(scope): ...`); it becomes the squash commit that drives the release.
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] User-facing text is in both `public/i18n/en.json` and `pt-BR.json`.
- [ ] Domain terms follow [GLOSSARY.md](../GLOSSARY.md).
